description: Ω9 healing fixture — the BROKEN world. A minimal UI provider: compose.click@1 receives the fresh capture's button inventory and clicks the button at the provider's OWN selector. The stale selector below ('#compose-btn', what the promoted SurfaceContract cites) no longer appears in the live inventory — the button moved. Behavioral drift: the op still answers ok (the provider is alive), it just misses the button. The FIXED twin (../provider-fixed, version 0.1.1) cites the re-observed selector; the amendment transport swaps them via recipe re-compile + atomic pin swap.

provider.doc: click the compose button: payload {buttons: string[]} — the fresh capture's button inventory; returns {clicked, triedSelector, buttonsSeen}. clicked iff the provider's selector is present in the inventory. Risk for this op would be DECLARED by a domain pack's CONTRACT (risk is contract-kind data); the fixture declares none, so the op is READ-class here.

capabilities.justification: Self-contained fixture: the world arrives in the payload (fresh capture inventory); no capabilities, no storage, no network.
